name: Kisan Card Punjab
description: Smart card for direct subsidy transfer on fertilizer, seeds, pesticides
benefits: Direct subsidy on fertilizer (PKR 1000/bag DAP, 500/bag Urea); Seeds subsidy; Pesticides subsidy; Access to agri-loans
documents_required: CNIC, Land ownership/tenancy proof, Bank account

name: Fertilizer Subsidy Punjab
description: Subsidy on DAP and Urea fertilizers through Kisan Card
benefits: PKR 1000 per bag DAP; PKR 500 per bag Urea; Direct to bank account via Kisan Card

name: Wheat Support Price Punjab
description: Government procurement of wheat at minimum support price
benefits: Guaranteed price PKR 3900/40kg; Procurement centers at mandis; Direct payment

name: Solar Tubewell Scheme Punjab
description: Subsidized solar-powered tubewells for irrigation
benefits: 50% subsidy on solar tubewell (max PKR 500,000); Reduced diesel costs; Clean energy
documents_required: CNIC, Land record, Electricity bill, Water availability certificate

name: Agriculture Loan Punjab
description: Low-interest loans for crop production, machinery, livestock
benefits: Crop loan up to PKR 500,000 at 4% markup; Machinery loan up to PKR 2,000,000; Livestock loan up to PKR 1,000,000
documents_required: CNIC, Land record, Kisan Card, Bank statement

name: Crop Insurance Punjab
description: Weather-index based crop insurance for major crops
benefits: Premium subsidy 50-80%; Payout on yield loss >30%; Coverage for wheat, cotton, rice, maize
documents_required: CNIC, Land record, Crop sowing certificate

name: Mechanization Subsidy Punjab
description: Subsidy on farm machinery and equipment
benefits: 50% subsidy on laser land leveler, combine harvester, planter, ridge maker, etc.
documents_required: CNIC, Land record, Quotation from dealer

name: Certified Seed Subsidy Punjab
description: Subsidy on certified seeds of major crops
benefits: 50% subsidy on certified wheat, cotton, rice, maize, vegetable seeds

name: Kisan Card Sindh
description: Smart card for subsidy transfer and farmer registration
benefits: Fertilizer subsidy; Seed subsidy; Access to credit; Crop insurance linkage
documents_required: CNIC, Land record (Form VII), Bank account

name: Fertilizer Subsidy Sindh
description: Subsidy on phosphatic and nitrogenous fertilizers
benefits: PKR 800/bag DAP; PKR 400/bag Urea; Via Kisan Card

name: Wheat Procurement Sindh
description: Government wheat procurement at support price
benefits: Support price PKR 4000/40kg; Mandi procurement; Direct bank transfer

name: Tube Well Subsidy Sindh
description: Subsidy on electric/diesel/solar tube wells
benefits: 40-50% subsidy on tube well installation; Max PKR 400,000
documents_required: CNIC, Land record, Water availability proof

name: Agriculture Credit Sindh
description: Production loans for crops and livestock
benefits: Crop loan up to PKR 300,000; Livestock loan up to PKR 500,000; Low markup

name: Kisan Card KPK
description: Digital farmer registration and subsidy delivery
benefits: Fertilizer, seed, pesticide subsidies; Credit access; Training programs

name: Fertilizer Subsidy KPK
description: Subsidy on major fertilizers for registered farmers
benefits: PKR 900/bag DAP; PKR 450/bag Urea; PKR 300/bag NPK

name: Crop Insurance KPK
description: Weather-index insurance for Khyber Pakhtunkhwa crops
benefits: Premium subsidy up to 80%; Coverage for wheat, maize, orchards, vegetables

name: Orchard Development KPK

benefits: Subsidy on fruit plants (apple, peach, apricot, citrus); Drip irrigation; Training

name: Livestock Insurance KPK
description: Insurance for dairy and meat animals
benefits: Premium subsidy 50%; Coverage for death, disease, theft; Cattle, buffalo, sheep, goat

name: Kisan Card Balochistan
description: Farmer registration and targeted subsidy delivery
benefits: Fertilizer subsidy; Seed support; Water management schemes

description: Solar tubewells, drip irrigation, karez rehabilitation
benefits: 70% subsidy on solar tubewells; Drip irrigation 50% subsidy; Karez cleaning

name: Date Palm Development Balochistan
description: Support for date palm cultivation in Mekran region

benefits: Free FMD, PPR, HS, BQ vaccines; Deworming; Veterinary camps
